title: Safe update, uninstall, and integrity lifecycle
objective: Implement compatibility checks, protected three-way updates, backup/rollback, dry-run lifecycle behavior, and conservative ownership-checked uninstall.
input: N06 canonical installation and ownership manifests
acceptance_criteria: Update stages and validates before swap; overlapping edits are surfaced and never silently overwritten.
Uninstall removes only unchanged CLI-owned artifacts and reports retained user edits.
Dry-run makes no filesystem or remote changes.
undo_classification: Restore staging backup; do not delete unowned or modified paths.
approval_requirements: Explicit user approval before mutating a real installation.
retry_policy: Initial attempt plus at most 2 retries; repeated integrity failure escalates without destructive retry.
blocking_reasons: N03, N06 and approved Issue required.
